Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class RenderLayer

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.RenderLayer
Record Components:
entityOnly - whether only selected entity-owned pixels contribute to the final composition
selector - predicate over copied entity metadata
brightness - finite nonnegative post-render RGB multiplier; 1 preserves brightness
opacity - composition opacity in 0..1; 1 is fully opaque
content - additional selection, or null to inherit request content
environment - per-field overrides, or null to inherit request environment
appearance - per-field overrides, or null to inherit request appearance
lighting - complete replacement lighting, or null to inherit request lighting
occlusion - visibility of selected entities relative to other captured geometry
color - pixel colour treatment, applied before brightness and opacity
public record RenderLayer(boolean entityOnly, EntitySelector selector, double brightness, double opacity, SceneContent content, RenderEnvironment environment, RenderAppearance appearance, RenderLighting lighting, Occlusion occlusion, LayerColor color) extends Record
One immutable pass in a RenderRecipe. Use scene() for a full-scene base and entities(EntitySelector) for a selected-entity overlay. Every pass derives independently from the same original capture; a preceding pass never changes a later pass's source evidence.

Unspecified content, environment, appearance and lighting inherit the request. Content can only narrow the request's selection. Environment and appearance inherit individual unspecified fields; explicit lighting replaces the complete light setup. Capture exclusions and viewer privacy remain authoritative in every pass.

Entity layers respect scene occlusion by default. Use Occlusion.SELECTED_ONLY explicitly for Xray visibility; selected entities still obscure each other. Primary-camera selection does not itself remove hidden geometry's lighting or shadows. Layer colour is applied to rendered pixels first, then brightness, then opacity during ordered composition.

    • entities

      public static RenderLayer entities(EntitySelector selector)
      Creates a selected-entity layer that respects other scene geometry by default. Native object-ID evidence determines which pixels belong to the selected entities.
      Parameters:
      selector - entity selection over copied metadata
      Returns:
      an entity layer with original colours, brightness 1 and opacity 1

    • brightness

      public RenderLayer brightness(double value)
      Sets a post-render RGB multiplier, after colour treatment and before opacity. This differs from exposure, which changes renderer appearance, and from light intensity, which lights surfaces.
      Parameters:
      value - finite multiplier at least 0; default 1
      Returns:
      a new layer with this setting

    • opacity

      public RenderLayer opacity(double value)
      Sets how strongly this layer is composited over earlier layers.
      Parameters:
      value - finite opacity from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque)
      Returns:
      a new layer with this setting

    • content

      public RenderLayer content(SceneContent value)
      Narrows request content for this pass without changing the original capture. Removed geometry is unavailable to camera, reflection and shadow rays. Use entity selection and occlusion to restrict camera output while retaining the surrounding scene geometry.
      Parameters:
      value - selection to intersect with request content, or null to inherit
      Returns:
      a new layer with this setting

      Returns:

    • occlusion

      public RenderLayer occlusion(Occlusion value)
      Selects whether other captured geometry occludes the selected entities. Selected entities always occlude each other; lighting geometry remains available.

      Returns:
      a new layer with this setting
